evidence.description: Doorbell usage pattern: ldr r12,[0x270188] loads base 0xB800C000, then polls status @ +0x0 (tst r10,#0x1; bne wait_loop), writes params to +0x10/14/18/1C, writes command to +0x0 to trigger
N32903 peripheral addressing (doorbell register not in standard peripheral map, likely custom/undocumented)

raw_note:
Migrated from docs/findings/mmio_map.md (Doorbell section)

Original confidence: 95%
Last verified: 2025-11-03

Register layout:
- +0x00: Command/Status (bit 0 = busy)
- +0x10: Parameter 1
- +0x14: Parameter 2
- +0x18: Parameter 3
- +0x1C: Parameter 4

Purpose: Display-related command/parameter interface
Note: Not in standard N32903 peripheral map, likely vendor-specific extension or misidentified peripheral
summary: Firmware uses doorbell/parameter interface @ 0xB800C000 for display-related commands. Register layout: +0x00 (command/status with bit 0 = busy), +0x10 (param1), +0x14 (param2), +0x18 (param3), +0x1C (param4). Pattern: poll busy bit, write 4 parameters, write command to trigger operation.
title: MMIO Doorbell/Parameter Block (0xB800C000)
